generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original Heroes of Might and Magic III hero portrait master, to be reduced to 58x64 and a face crop 48x32 pixels. Subject: Lee Sin from League of Legends, recognizable bald Ionian adult martial monk, weathered tan skin, red cloth blindfold fully covering both eyes and tied behind his head, short dark goatee, red scarf and bare muscular shoulders with simple leather straps, strong solemn face. Background textured golden ochre and blue mountain haze. Close compact head-and-shoulders portrait, entire hair/hat silhouette within frame, face large and readable, three-quarter view. Painterly late-1990s fantasy game portrait, textured hand-painted oil miniature, natural anatomy and individual facial planes, strong warm light from upper left, crisp readable eyes and silhouette, restrained metallic highlights. Original composition, not a copy of a splash painting. No anime, no chibi, no glossy modern key art, no photoreal photograph, no typography, no border, no watermark. One character only, square composition.
